ops.title: Adoption decision: athome grows the autonomous outer loop; cc-steer adopts athome for experimentation
ops.body: Decision (2026-07-16, user-approved cc-steer plan lets-see-what-we-synchronous-cookie.md): athome is the experimentation platform for its consumers — cc-steer re-scoped its P4/P6 backlog (native experiment.toml/budget.py/backlog.py) onto adopting athome.research + athome spend machinery. athome in turn grows the autoresearch OUTER loop (policy-bounded proposer + campaign runner, fully autonomous under hard caps, human-gated mode as a config knob) plus hardening adopted from github.com/Danau5tin/ai-trains-ai: contract memory/baseline visibility, preflight-before-spend, infra-vs-candidate failure classification, frozen baselines keyed by Comparability (closes their eval-cache staleness footgun structurally), auto-retros as the oversight channel, quiet-alarm watchdog. Their control-inversion RL bridge is noted for a future RL-trained proposer; their host-subprocess trust model is NOT adopted (git-archive isolation is stronger). First consumer workload: cc-steer's watcher base-model sweep via a score-only lane writing athome.train.write_metric.
